Package GUI

Class WaitingListController

java.lang.Object
GUI.WaitingListController
public class WaitingListController extends Object
Controller for the Waiting List screen. This class allows visitors, subscribers, and guides to view their waiting list entries and leave the waiting list if the reservation has not yet been confirmed.
